test: none: the issue is open and has no fixing PR (SolidCraft's kernel work is paused, #3992), so `pr` points at the PR that adds this fixture, as the loader requires a /pull/ URL; the issue itself reproduces it (an Extrude, Operation = Join) and its triage comment; the numbers here are analytic
summary: Extrude (Join) of a circular-segment profile that sits in the wide-end opening of a tube whose inner surface is a cone failed on SolidCraft's earlier kernel with 'boolean Union: the operation failed: no result' (reproduced on 0.24.1 and on main): 'not supported yet: the exact fallback for where the bodies meet (faces that touch, or cross at a shallow angle) takes planar faces only, and the target has 6 curved faces (cone, cylinder) and the tool has 2 curved faces (cylinder)'. Geometry is the issue's: the tube is the revolve about z of the section (r, z) = (20, 0), (4, 20), (28.8, 20), (28.8, 0), so its bore is a cone from radius 20 at z = 0 to 4 at z = 20 and its wall is a cylinder of radius 28.8; the tool is the circular segment of the radius-20 circle on the far side of the chord y = -14.08 (area 115.92 mm^2), extruded 22 mm from z = 0, built here as a cylinder intersected with a box. The volumes are closed form up to one integral, evaluated by Gauss-Legendre quadrature (400 nodes on each of two smooth pieces) and cross-checked on a 2000 x 2000 grid (within 3e-3 mm^3). The tolerance is 0.01 mm^3, as in the other boolean cases.

cases.name: join_segment_into_tube
cases.note: #7773: the join as the issue made it: the circular-segment prism (the part of the disc of radius 20 on the side y <= -14.08, 22 mm tall from the tube's wide end z = 0) united with the tube. The prism's bottom lies in the tube's wide-end face and its wall meets the cone along a curve.

cases.name: overlap_of_segment_and_tube
cases.note: The same two bodies intersected: the part of the tube's wall inside the prism.

volume.formula: overlap = int_0^20 [A(20) - A(20 - 0.8*z)] dz (A = 0 once 20 - 0.8*z <= c, i.e. z >= 7.4), Gauss-Legendre on [0, 7.4] and [7.4, 20]

cases.name: segment_minus_tube
cases.note: The prism with the tube cut away: two pieces remain. One lies inside the conical bore, where the cone's radius is still above 14.08 (z < 7.4), and the other is the 2 mm of the prism above the tube's narrow end (z from 20 to 22).

volume.formula: V(segment) - overlap; A(r) = r^2*acos(c/r) - c*sqrt(r^2 - c^2), c = 14.08; V = 22*A(20); overlap = int_0^20 [A(20) - A(20 - 0.8*z)] dz (A = 0 once 20 - 0.8*z <= c, i.e. z >= 7.4), Gauss-Legendre on [0, 7.4] and [7.4, 20]
